# do_PackageReport() | Dependency status

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Generates a **status report** of SCpubr and its dependencies. Shows which optional packages are installed and which functions are available.

---

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: true
SCpubr::do_PackageReport()
```

---

## Extended report

Show detailed package versions and available functions:

```{r}
#| eval: true
SCpubr::do_PackageReport(extended = TRUE)
```

---

## Parameter reference

| Parameter | Description | Default |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `startup` | Include welcome message | `FALSE` |
| `extended` | Detailed package info | `FALSE` |
